package.name: giraffe_gazebo_plugins
package.description: Gazebo Harmonic (gz-sim8) system plugin that creates and removes a runtime fixed joint between the Giraffe arm's gripper and a runtime-selectable object (red_cube, blue_cube, yellow_cube, or any other spawned model), exposed as ROS 2 services (/gripper/attach, /gripper/detach, type giraffe_gazebo_plugins/srv/AttachDetach, defined in this same package) for use from a MoveIt Task Constructor pick-and-place pipeline.
